delta.current_problem: F2 forbids composing historical higher-tier runtime evidence with newer repository CI unless explicit RUNTIME_SUBJECT_INVARIANT evidence exists, but the safe evidentiary shape of that invariant was not specified.
delta.best_supported_change: Define the invariant as a nonauthoritative conservative non-interference witness, not semantic-equivalence proof. Bind original subject/receipt, exact integration boundary, declared and observed dependency evidence, selector/config/environment/runtime-tool identities, successor change set and dependency-completeness class. Unknown closure fails closed.
safe_integration_order: E3 toy falsifier outside production boundary
E4 F2-specific ablation against frozen fixtures/receipts if E3 passes
E5 stdlib-only build candidate and Trigger-4 inbox handoff if E4 shows useful discrimination
Trigger-4 adopts only at an explicit safe generation boundary and remains sole implementation/acceptance path

conflicts_and_supersessions: Supersedes any informal interpretation that source SHA equality or provenance alone proves successor semantic equivalence.
Does not supersede active WP206 G6 or WP901 G5 claims and must not mutate their owned paths.
Does not supersede the runtime-credit convergence directive; it supplies a candidate evidence contract beneath that authority.
expected_benefit: Preserve exact-source higher-tier runtime evidence across demonstrably irrelevant successor changes without rerun churn, while making uncertainty invalidate/defer rather than silently composing stale credit.

runtime_resource_implications.risk: dependency-closure construction may cost more engineering effort than replay for highly dynamic boundaries

counterhypothesis: Dynamic F2 boundaries prevent conservative closure often enough that the evaluator almost always invalidates/defer; if so, retire the mechanism and keep replay/defer as the simpler policy.
acceptance_gate: E3 must reproduce both a true unrelated-change certification and adversarial false-certification failures for weaker declared-only/observed-only strategies while the hybrid remains fail closed.
staleness_rule: If RUNTIME_CREDIT_CONVERGENCE_DIRECTIVE.md, any mapped integration boundary, or the relevant active workpackage generation changes before E5 handoff, set STALE_REVIEW_REQUIRED and re-map before promotion.
